name: BBXToken
fix_description: In _transfer, the burn logic checks block.timestamp >= lastBurnTime + lastBurnGapTime but never updates lastBurnTime after burning. The condition is always true, so every transfer burns from the pair and syncs. Fix by adding lastBurnTime = block.timestamp after the burn.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very simple protocol-specific logic abuse: buy a small amount of BBX, repeatedly call transfer(address(this), 0) to trigger the flawed burn/liquidity logic, then dump inflated value into the LP. It is only a few steps, uses no flash loan or complex multi-contract routing, and the PoC is short and straightforward once the token bug is identified.
